note: Folder navigation for a tool-using model. Reading this file does not run a solver, bind a provider, or qualify a result. Every tracked folder has MCP.md. mcp/folder-index.json lists those contracts. Neither authorizes execution.

folders.mandate: The ciw package owns contracts, sessions, and the ncp_* gateway. A module path is not a grant.
Machine catalogs. They name tools and folders. They do not authorize execution.
Scientific pages and mandates. Reading a page is not a run and not a qualification.
Keep the suite. Do not delete or weaken a test to make a call look successful. A passing handler test is not physical qualification.
Frozen inputs for profile preparation and synthetic examples. An example file is not a measurement.
ncp_ledger_read. qualified stays not_assessed. proved_heat is a read, not an SP1 proof.
Imported subtrees. Not a substitute for a host-selected pin. Leakage and BIM refuse the vendored directory.
Julia, native interop, and proof workers. Unbound until a host selects the real executable. Do not invent one.
Godot scenes and scripts. Not an MCP grant and not a physical simulation result.
Historical inventories and findings. Not a new execution and not a waiver of open gates.
Local check records. Not physical qualification and not a release.
Check and prepare scripts. A model does not pass a script path as authority.
Operator consoles. They do not add a grant the control tools lack.
Deployment notes. Packaging is not execution.
Container definitions. A built image is not a qualified installation.
Retained delivery artifacts. Not a new scientific result.
Research scripts. Not profile grants.
Work orders. Not execution.
Dependency locks. A lock file does not bind a provider.
Third-party notices. Not scientific authority.

mandates.rule: Advertised, bound, and granted are different. authorizes_execution stays false on every index row.
The same attempt returns the same run. A different request under that attempt refuses. Replay writes a new occurrence.
Partial fields stay missing. Do not fill them.
A completed graph, a PASS, a LOCAL check, a spread, or a held inspection does not book freight, verify physics, or release a part.
Leakage and BIM keep their retained pins. The vendored subtree is not that checkout, and the pin is not overridden.
proved_heat is ncp_ledger_read. It is not an SP1 proof.
ncp_domain_run and ncp_fluid_field are bounded synthetic calculations. They are not measurements or forecasts.
Tests, independent checks, and retained refusals stay. Do not drop a verification workflow to widen a grant.
Only the host launch selects a checkout or interpreter. Tool arguments and evidence cannot.
External work, board refit, and knowledge are separate hosts. Do not fold them into ncp_run_submit.

not_grants: SP1 proved heat as a proof
a session workflow whose binding_status is explicit_bindings_required, unless the host has already selected that pin
shared discovery, typed composition, frame transformations, device gateway, and private provider discovery

verification.note: Run the suite that owns the claim. This map does not run it.
